comment: Coverage that is not a direct reference from a test source. protocols: runner checks of scripts/ci/native_platforms.py that exercise the function natively on every platform. unsupported: per-platform technical reason. not_testable: why no native test can call the function.

kiso/thread.*.darwin-arm64: OS threads and channels are implemented for Linux x86-64 only; this target rejects programs that use them (thread-natives-fail-closed)
kiso/thread.*.windows-amd64: OS threads and channels are implemented for Linux x86-64 only; this target rejects programs that use them (thread-natives-fail-closed)
kiso/thread.*.linux-arm64: OS threads and channels are implemented for Linux x86-64 only; this target rejects programs that use them (thread-natives-fail-closed)

kiso/thread.*.windows-arm64: OS threads and channels are implemented for Linux x86-64 only; this target rejects programs that use them (thread-natives-fail-closed)

kiso/reactor.*.windows-amd64: the reactor primitives (reactor_open, reactor_ctl, reactor_wait, reactor_signal, reactor_ack) are implemented for linux-amd64 only; the Windows backend is planned (docs/async-networking.md, phase D) and the primitives currently fail closed with an error
kiso/reactor.*.windows-arm64: the reactor primitives (reactor_open, reactor_ctl, reactor_wait, reactor_signal, reactor_ack) are implemented for linux-amd64 only; the Windows ARM64 backend is planned (docs/async-networking.md, phase D) and the primitives currently fail closed with an error

kiso/async.*.darwin-arm64: the native task runtime (kiso/async, kiso/async/net) exists for linux-amd64 only; on darwin-arm64 `mio build` refuses a program that uses it with E0805 (checked natively by async-capability-rejection) and `mio test` refuses its package, so no covering test image can run here; the frontend half is checked by async-frontend-accepted (docs/async-await.md section 3)
